## ⚠️ CRITICAL ALERTS

🟡 **Lactate 2.1, ↓ from 4.8** — Improving but not normalized. Continue q6h trending. If rises, reassess for stump leak or ongoing sepsis.

🟡 **Cr 1.4, ↓ from 1.6** — AKI resolving with resuscitation. Continue IVF, avoid nephrotoxins, trend with AM BMP.

🟡 **Hgb 11.8 post-1u PRBC** (was 10.2 pre-transfusion) — Stable. Recheck with AM CBC. Threshold to transfuse again if <8.

🟢 **WBC 14.2, ↓ from 18.9** — Trending down on pip-tazo. Continue current abx regimen.

🟢 **Pressor wean in progress** — Norepi 0.12 → 0.05 overnight. MAPs >65. Continue wean, target off by tonight.

## 📋 DAY PLAN

**Discharge blocker:** Active pressor requirement, post-op ileus, POD#1 from emergent surgery — not going home today. Goal is ICU stabilization and physiologic recovery.

- [ ] AM labs: CBC, BMP, lactate
- [ ] Continue pressor wean — target off norepi by tonight
- [ ] Assess for return of bowel function (flatus, bowel sounds)
- [ ] If flatus → start clear liquids
- [ ] Assess for extubation readiness (was intubated yesterday, status update needed)
- [ ] Stoma nurse consult for ostomy education
- [ ] Wound assessment — midline incision + stoma site
- [ ] PT/OT eval when off pressors
- [ ] Pain: transition PCA → scheduled PO when tolerating diet
- [ ] Continue SQH for VTE prophylaxis while on bedrest
- [ ] Family update on progress

## WHITAKER, Harold | 68M | ICU Bed 4 | POD#1
s/p emergent Hartmann for perforated sigmoid diverticulitis (Hinchey III)

### Overnight
- Pressors weaning: norepi 0.12 → 0.05, MAPs >65
- Received 1u PRBC (Hgb 10.2 → 11.8)
- UOP 40-50cc/hr, pain controlled on PCA
- No fevers, no stoma output yet

### Current Status
On pressors but weaning. NPO, no flatus. Foley in place. PCA for pain. Stoma pink and viable per nursing, no output yet.

### Yesterday's Plan → Today
- **Aggressive resuscitation** → Done. Lactate 4.8 → 2.1. Responding well.
- **Wean pressors as tolerated** → In progress. Norepi 0.12 → 0.05.
- **Serial lactate q6h** → Done and trending down.
- **Assess for extubation** → Was planned for today if hemodynamics improved — assess this AM.
- **Stoma nurse consult** → Ordered yesterday, pending. Follow up.

### Key Context
No prior abdominal surgeries. End colostomy (Hartmann). Was in septic shock on arrival yesterday (lac 4.8, BP 94/58). Home meds include aspirin and metoprolol — both held. Full code.
